title: Concomitant Prediction of the Ki67 and PIT-1 Expression in Pituitary Adenoma Using Different Radiomics Models.
authors: Liu, Fangzheng; Zang, Yuying; Feng, Limei; Shi, Xinyao; Wu, Wentao; Liu, Xin; Song, Yifan; Xu, Jintian; Gui, Songbai; Chen, Xuzhu
journal: Journal of imaging informatics in medicine
one_liner_zh: 该文用影像组学模型预测垂体腺瘤中Ki67和PIT-1表达，属于临床影像诊断，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模，亦无AI/物理模拟方法用于分子互作研究，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: To preoperatively predict the high expression of Ki67 and positive pituitary transcription factor 1 (PIT-1) simultaneously in pituitary adenoma (PA) using three different radiomics models. METHODS: A total of 247 patients with PA (training set: n = 198; test set: n = 49) were included in this retrospective study. The imaging features were extracted from preoperative contrast-enhanced T1WI (T1CE), T1-weighted imaging (T1WI), and T2-weighted imaging (T2WI). Feature selection was performed using Spearman's rank correlation coefficient and least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO). The classic machine learning (CML), deep learning (DL), and deep learning radiomics (DLR) models were constructed using logistic regression (LR), support vector machine (SVM), and multi-layer perceptron (MLP) algorithms. The area under the receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve (AUC), sensitivity, specificity, accuracy, negative predictive value (NPV) and positive predictive value (PPV) were calculated for the training and test sets. In addition, combined with clinical characteristics, the best CML and the best DL models (SVM classifier), the DL radiomics nomogram (DLRN) was constructed to aid clinical decision-making. RESULTS: Seven CML features, 96 DL features, and 107 DLR features were selected to construct CML, DL and DLR models. Compared to CML and DL model, the DLR model had the best performance. The AUC, sensitivity, specificity, accuracy, NPV and PPV were 0.827, 0.792, 0.800, 0.796, 0.800 and 0.792 in the test set, respectively. CONCLUSIONS: Compared with CML and DL models, the DLR model shows the best performance in predicting the Ki67 and PIT-1 expression in PAs simultaneously.
abstract_zh: 目的：利用三种不同的影像组学模型，术前同时预测垂体腺瘤（PA）中Ki67高表达及垂体转录因子1（PIT-1）阳性。方法：本研究回顾性纳入247例PA患者（训练集：n = 198；测试集：n = 49）。从术前增强T1WI（T1CE）、T1加权成像（T1WI）和T2加权成像（T2WI）中提取影像特征。特征选择采用Spearman秩相关系数和最小绝对收缩与选择算子（LASSO）。使用逻辑回归（LR）、支持向量机（SVM）和多层感知器（MLP）算法构建经典机器学习（CML）、深度学习（DL）和深度学习影像组学（DLR）模型。计算训练集和测试集的受试者工作特征（ROC）曲线下面积（AUC）、敏感性、特异性、准确性、阴性预测值（NPV）和阳性预测值（PPV）。此外，结合临床特征，构建了基于最佳CML和最佳DL模型（SVM分类器）的DL影像组学列线图（DLRN），以辅助临床决策。结果：共选择7个CML特征、96个DL特征和107个DLR特征，用于构建CML、DL和DLR模型。与CML和DL模型相比，DLR模型表现最佳。在测试集中，AUC、敏感性、特异性、准确性、NPV和PPV分别为0.827、0.792、0.800、0.796、0.800和0.792。结论：与CML和DL模型相比，DLR模型在同时预测PA中Ki67和PIT-1表达方面表现最佳。
